newsitem.title: USA: Atmos sees expense in restructring.
newsitem.headline: Atmos sees expense in restructring.

text.p: Atmos Energy Corp said Wednesday it would restructure its customer service operations by setting up a network of payment centers and establishing a central customer support call center, and that the changes would cause it recognize the expense in fiscal 1997.

The company also said there will be a net reduction of approximately 240 positions as a result of these changes over the next 12 months as business office operations are restructured, customer support call centers are staffed and new operating practices are implemented.

The payment centers, said Atmos, will be located in businesses such as convenience stores and supermarkets, and should be in place by early summer. The central customer support call center will open by early 1998.
The company's 108 business offices will be closed for routine business traffic, but 77 service centers will remain.
The company said it expects to realize significant cost savings as a result of these changes in fiscal 1998 and beyond..
